extracted_details.description_text: The supplied INF identifies Surface Integration Driver version 120.8.4.0, dated 05/06/2026, and targets ACPI\MSHW0530 on 64-bit Windows 10 build 19041 or later. INFDescriptionData was semantically analyzed: it installs SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys as a demand-start kernel service, copies three Surface power-policy provisioning packages, associates OS-specific package paths, and configures a 14-point display backlight-power curve for Windows energy estimation. A separate registry section defines KIP, battery-estimate, long-press screen-refresh, and BitLocker request-limit values, but that section is not referenced by the displayed install directives, so those values are not treated as confirmed applied changes. Exact-version Microsoft catalog searches did not identify an official package or release-note page for SurfaceIntegrationDriver 120.8.4.0; no verified previous, latest, or same-family release notes were found, so the functional description is based on the supplied INF rather than release-note claims.
key_components: SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys: system-class, demand-start kernel driver, associated with ACPI\MSHW0530.
Surface.Power.Policy.Defaults.ppkg: default Surface power-policy provisioning package copied to the DriverStore.
Surface.Power.Policy.WIN10.Defaults.ppkg and Surface.Power.Policy.WIN11-0.Defaults.ppkg: OS-specific power-policy package files registered by the hardware AddReg section.
SurfaceIntegrationDriver_AddBrightnessCurve_AddReg: configures a 14-point brightness-to-backlight-power curve and display energy-estimation values.
SurfaceIntegrationDriver_Device_AddReg: contains additional KIP, battery estimate, power-button, and fvevol registry settings, but is not referenced by the displayed install directives.
key_functionalities: Binds the system driver to the INF-declared ACPI\MSHW0530 hardware ID on 64-bit Windows starting at build 19041.
Installs SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys as a demand-start kernel service.
Copies default, Windows 10, and Windows 11 Surface power-policy provisioning packages and records paths to the OS-specific packages.
Registers a 14-point brightness-percentage/backlight-power curve for Windows display energy estimation.
Defines PlatformKipSupported=1 with an INF comment associating it with KIP power-saving features; the containing registry section is not linked by the shown install directives.

Defines settings to hide estimated remaining battery discharge time, enable screen refresh after a long power-button press, and set fvevol encryption/decryption/crypto request values to 0x40; these are in the unreferenced registry section and are not asserted as applied by this INF excerpt.
No verified release notes were found, so no version-specific fixes or changes are claimed.
